system.description: Beginning, at 6th level, Whenever you cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that requires a creature to make a Saving throw while you are wielding your Dread Weapon, you may spend 1 Arsenal charge to impose a -2 penalty to the save. If the target is Stalked by you, the target instead makes their save at disadvantage.
